author: Yffe
content: Failing tests at thermite-lower/tests/divergence_spec_call_cast_unthreaded_paths.rs::loop_invariant_spec_call_arith_arg_casts_to_declared_param_type + ::fn_level_dec_measure_spec_call_arith_arg_casts_to_declared_param_type demonstrate the divergence (run with --ignored; both FAIL: the loop-inv path emits s_dec((i + 0) as u64) and the spec_dec path emits decreases s_dec((n + 0) as u64) for a u32-param callee). LIVE-CONFIRMED: forge check on the loop-inv fixture dies E0308 'expected u32, found u64' at L0 though the source is correct — the exact #225 class. Root cause: lower_loop (lower.rs, the spec Ctx for inv clauses + the loop dec measure) and spec_dec (Ctx::spec_seq()) never call .with_spec_fn_param_types(..); the c02b9a6b threading reaches only lower_spec_fn/lower_fn_signature/lower_external_body_fn. lift_immutable_preconds re-lowers req clauses under the same unthreaded loop ctx (same root cause).
